caveats: These files contain metrics and hashes only, never music or beat annotation lists.
GTZAN has known related recordings; separate filenames and exact PCM hashes do not establish artist/song independence.
Holdout means not used to choose this fixed rule; it is not a claim about all upstream pretraining data.
Beat-reference F1 is not gameplay accuracy or a full rating of musical-note quality.

phase.protocol: one finger only; dense constant-factor model-ordinal blocks >=8 beats; factor=ceil(.3/local median interval), 9-beat median context; consistent downbeat residue (>=2 votes, >=75%) else measured onset strength mass; no retiming; 2/3/4 unchanged

medianDevelopment.protocol: Primary beat binding only: replace adjacent next interval with median of up to nine positive intervals indexed i-4..i+4 (edge-clipped). Preserve min(.09,span*.2), score, used-set priority, half/quarter/free binding, raw/decoded clock and all chart logic. No per-track tuning.

medianHoldout.protocol: Primary beat binding only: replace adjacent next interval with median of up to nine positive intervals indexed i-4..i+4 (edge-clipped). Preserve min(.09,span*.2), score, used-set priority, half/quarter/free binding, raw/decoded clock and all chart logic. No per-track tuning.
